# D’TAILOR

> African high fashion house in Accra, Ghana. Nigerian founder. Atelier and newly opened storefront on Ecobank Spintex Road. Kaftans, agbadas, women’s wear, ready-to-wear and suits. Shoppable for clients anywhere via WhatsApp. No cart, no accounts, no published prices.

Tagline: Designed for your fit and comfort

Statement: Your personality, our craftsmanship. One unique creation.

Live site: https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/

## Routes

- [Home](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/): House introduction and five department doors
- [Store](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/shop/): Boutique index of five departments
- [Kaftans](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/shop/kaftans/)
- [Agbadas](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/shop/agbadas/)
- [Women’s wear](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/shop/womens/)
- [Ready to wear](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/shop/ready-to-wear/)
- [Suits](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/shop/suits/)
- [Collection](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/collection/): Lookbook gallery
- [About](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/about/): Founder portrait and Accra storefront
- [Book a fitting](https://jjman9797.github.io/dtalior/book/): Request a day, time of day and garment on WhatsApp

Product pages live at `/dtalior/shop/<department>/<product>/`.

## Shop notes

- Buying is a WhatsApp message that names the look, colour, sleeve and size.
- Price is confirmed with the house before work begins. No prices are published.
- Sizes: S, M, L, XL, 2X, 3X, 4X, Made to measure. Sizes mean a look can be requested, not stock counts.
- Founder name is not published. Use [FOUNDER NAME] if a name field is required.
- Opening hours are not published. Fitting days are requestable. The house confirms the hour on WhatsApp.
